title: Kitamura of Deszo
text: “What a selfish creature. Even the original wouldn’t complain about a form like this, surely…”

“Don’t act out of malice! Why must you always chase after such fleeting amusement? There’s a limit to foolishness! You absolute idiot! That’s exactly why you fell into that trap and nearly got turned into a horse-dung chocolate factory, I say.”
“Heh… you dare talk back? Trampling on my good will like that… very well. Then I’ll approach Shield Hero in a form that leaves no strings attached.”
And with that, Rafumi transformed once more, indeed.
As for what that form turned out to be… from the neck down it was Filo-tan, but the face alone remained Rafumi’s.
Ugh… indeed.
I had no idea what possible intention lay behind such a form.
Ugh, it was an insult to Filo-tan, plain and simple.
A primal wave of disgust welled up in me, making me feel sick.
And yet, even if I wanted to blast it to smithereens, it was wearing Filo-tan’s face, which made attacking rather difficult.
“Well, Spear Hero? Behold, Angel Rafumi. Go on, feel the moe.”
“Why is only the face left in its original form!”
“Because this is my true face. Now then… shall we get going?”
“I won’t allow it! Brio—”
In a flash, Rafumi switched the face back to Filo-tan’s.
“Spear Guy~”
“Guh!”
I instantly canceled my Brionac.
There was no way I could attack Filo-tan!
The moment I halted my attack, Rafumi switched the face right back.
“This is the duty of the guardian of love, protecting Shield Hero from Gaelion’s affections. As for Shield Hero, just have him go count the wrinkles on a tent or something.”
“Stop it! No—please stop, I beg you! I’ll refrain from forcing my requests on Father and everyone around him from now on, so please, have mercy!”
I rushed around in front of Rafumi and bowed my head, but since it just kept marching on as if refusing to listen, I dropped into a full dogeza to plead.

“What’s wrong with a little fun? You want to get this done before the female Gaelion shows up, don’t you? Don’t worry, Spear Hero—I’ll send you video proof. ‘Hey there, Spear Guy, you watching?’ Something like that. As for the horse-dung chocolate business, I figured I’d get serious about that too.”
What kind of home-wrecker are you… the Father in my head muttered at Rafumi.
Don’t come out here, Father! You’ll get violated!
“I really need you to stop! I’m sorry about almost turning you into horse-dung chocolate!”
“Oh? Well, fine then. But there won’t be a second time. Watch your words.”
“Yes, sir!”
With a pop, Rafumi returned to its original form and walked off, and I stayed in my dogeza the whole while, waiting it out.
Only once Rafumi’s presence had completely vanished did I start trembling.
Guhhhh…
That was close. In more ways than one.
To think that poking at Rafumi’s weak point—that old incident from its past—would provoke this kind of behavior.
Ugh…
I staggered back up to my feet.
“Huh? Motoyasu-kun?”
And just then, Father happened to appear.
He seemed to be safe and sound, thankfully.
I wobbled over to Father to consult him.
“Father. How do I go about exterminating Rafumi? Do you know anyone who could take it down? I want to send them a letter, I say.”
Did Father have any connections to someone strong enough to deal with Rafumi?
“You’ve got this look on your face like something out of one of those boys’ manga about hunting yokai, the kind with the dad who’s just an eyeball—what happened?”
I had no idea what Father was talking about.

Was the Father in my head calling me “Kitamura of Deszo”? Same up to a point, I guess… or wait, “Kitamura of Dedede”? In that case, the great king would be you, and you’d end up a penguin, he said—though I didn’t quite follow.
The penguin was Father, apparently.
“A yokai indeed. I want an exterminator.”
Could someone please exterminate the yokai known as Rafumi?
I prayed for it with all my heart.
It was a yokai that couldn’t even be brought down with Beast Trance.
“Not totally sure what’s going on, but don’t fight too much, okay?”
I wanted to explain everything, but the whole ordeal had sapped even that much will out of me.
Quite literally, it had been an extremely dangerous incident for me.
If asked which was worse—this, or Rival stealing Father’s virginity—it was a contest I couldn’t afford to lose, I say.
A few days after suffering that psychological damage thanks to Rafumi.
We were traveling around Melromarc.
“Wild Filolial-sama are here!”
This time of year, this location… there was no mistaking it!
“Ah… I guess wild Filolials live around here or something?”
“You see them around this time of year.”
“I suppose various circumstances put them right around here. Shall we chase them down and capture them alive?”
Rafumi said something ominous.
“I won’t allow it. Wild Filolial-sama are precious too.”
“How boring. Wolf, care to go hunting?”
“Vof… no thanks.”
Rafumi tried to rope Wolf into it, but got flatly refused.
Serves it right.
“Then how about you, Theodore? A rabbit going Filolial hunting. You’ve been putting in your running lately, haven’t you?”
“It’s clearer than fire what would happen to me if I took you up on that offer.”
“Sigh… how boring. If we found them and either captured the lot or wiped them all out, we might get an event sc
“Even though if we found them, capturing or wiping out everyone might allow us to skip the event scenes.”
“What are you even saying?!”
“Well, the meaning of doing that is thin...”
As we were chatting like that, a wild Filolial-sama quickly spotted us along with Yuki-chan, Kou, and Firo-tan. Of course, there were also many other Filolial-samas pulling carriages.
They raised voices of vigilance.
“Look, Spear Hero. Someone like you right now can run and chase after them, can't you? Go on and keep chasing them forever.”
“I refuse Rafumi's order. I feel like I should not chase them.”

Besides, if my memory is correct... in some cases, isn't this the kind of event that serves as a sign of a fiancé appearing? It makes me remember the loop where we stayed in Melromarc. This loop has also ended up staying similarly. Although, unlike that loop in various ways, Itsuki and Ren are already accompanying us in this situation.
Still, I also have a slight desire to chase them. Let us endure this impulse by petting Yuki-chan. I would also love to leap at Firo-tan, but Rafumi might be in disguise.
“M-Motoyasu-sama. Thank you very much!”
While we were watching, the wild Filolial-samas ran away and left.
“By the way, Father-in-law. The reason we do not easily encounter wild Filolial-samas is because Yuki-chan and the other Filolial-samas take care not to step into their territory.”
“I-Is that so?”
“Indeed.”
“Is that so? Nn?”

Firo-tan seemed to indicate there was no particular reason. However, Sakura-chan seemed to have been considerate...? No, perhaps this Firo-tan is reacting this way because she is actually Rafumi... could that be it? If she were the real one, does that mean Firo-tan does not think things through very well? Father-in-law from the very first world spoke as if he had seen wild Filolial-samas before. I recall hearing that back then, Father-in-law and the others only had Firo-tan, so their sense of camaraderie was apparently weak. Perhaps they encountered them often without thinking much about it.
“Now then... We saw wild Filolial on the road, and I hope nothing out of the ordinary happensー.”
As the circus caravan was peacefully proceeding along a tranquil road..., a group appeared, drawing closer.
“Hmm... Finally making an appearance, and with this, my guard duty is also fulfilled. Firo, from now on you must learn various things properly.”
“Nn?”

Rafumi is teaching Firo-tan something or another. What nonsense are they uttering? More importantly, it is the approaching group. Why have they appeared this time? Father-in-law has not done anything to become all that famous. He merely traveled from place to place doing circus work and slave trading, and the famous ones are Ren, whose body double is Rafumi, and Itsuki—the assassin Risuca—who operates in the shadows and slaughters nobles one after another.
“Any challengers!”
A high-handed Melromarc knight called out.
